# The DC harness errored all 62 cells at setup: an ORDERING DEADLOCK in the Epic-field readiness gate

## CORRECTION: this ticket's original root cause was WRONG

**Originally filed (by me) as "9790's field-readiness budget is too short".** That diagnosis was
false, and `review-plan` blocked the plan for it. Recorded here rather than quietly rewritten,
because the wrong version is the more instructive artifact.

I took the decision rule out of 9790's own `not_ready_message` — *"if the inventory contains no
`customfield_*` entries whatsoever the plugin is still starting and the budget is too short"* — and
treated it as a measurement. **That rule is wrong AND self-confirming**: an empty custom-field
inventory is exactly what a Jira instance with no project returns, so it "confirms" itself under the
one condition it cannot distinguish. It misdiagnosed 9790's own author, then me, then this ticket,
and it cost a 50-minute harness run. I made it worse by instructing the implementing agent not to
re-derive it. The agent verified first anyway and refuted it.

## The PROVEN root cause: an ordering deadlock

**GreenHopper provisions `Epic Link` / `Epic Name` when the FIRST Jira Software project is created.**
9790's gate waited for those fields at SESSION START — before any project exists — so it waited for a
capability that only the action it was blocking could create. No budget can satisfy it.

Discriminating experiment, GitHub Actions run **30981084637** (run on the ~15-min probe workflow, not
the ~50-min harness):

    before any project                    27 fields,  0 customfield_*,  Epic Link False
    after 180s QUIET, still no project    27 fields,  0 customfield_*,  Epic Link False
    0.05s AFTER project create (HTTP 201) 55 fields, 13 customfield_*,  Epic Link TRUE

The quiet-settle leg is what makes it discriminating: it supplies **time without the action**, and
time did nothing. That single cause explains every symptom — both the 600s and the 1800s budgets
failing with byte-identical inventories, the container sitting idle (`Startup is complete` at
05:40:58, `Plugins upgrades completed successfully` at 05:41:53, then ~29 minutes of silence), run
30964805133 passing 62/62 before the gate landed, and both probe runs failing the same way since 1387.

## Evidence of the failure

Harness run **30975323866** at `31f352d535`: **1 xfailed, 62 ERRORS in 606.98s** — every cell errored
at fixture setup, none ran. The preceding run **30964805133** at `c3fb869ab5` (before the gate landed)
was **62 passed, 1 xfailed, 0 failed**.

## The fix — the budget went DOWN, not up

Check the Epic fields **after** provisioning, not at session start. Because provisioning is measured
at **0.0512s** (run 30981084637; confirmed 0.032-0.058s, always 1 poll, 57 times in run 30982731669),
the budget was **lowered 600s -> 120s** — ~2400x the measurement, still bounded so a genuine degrade
fails in two minutes instead of ten. Raising it, which the original plan proposed, would have made
every failure slower without making any of them pass.

9790's misleading message text is rewritten as part of this fix, so the refuted rule cannot mislead
the next reader.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] the readiness check runs where the capability can actually exist — after provisioning — and the
      ORDERING is the fix, not the budget
- [x] the budget is sized from a MEASURED provisioning time with the measurement recorded (run id +
      observed delay) as a cited constant, not guessed
- [x] the harness run is GREEN end to end (0 failed, 0 errored cells) on `main`, with the run id
      recorded
- [x] the wait still FAILS loudly on a genuine degrade (custom fields present but not the Epic ones),
      pinned by a test whose fixture varies that axis
- [x] `JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT`'s default and override path are documented where an operator
      hitting a timeout will find them

## Verification

* **Green on `main`:** harness run **30986591446** at `0df44dcbc9` — `62 passed, 1 xfailed`, canary
  `collected=63 executed=62 skipped=1`, **0 failed / 0 errored**, no FAILED or ERROR lines in the log.
  This is epic [rebar:e369-a449-4773-48fb]'s exit-bar evidence.
* **Degrade path still loud:** `test_a_degraded_image_still_fails_the_capability_check_loudly`
  (`tests/unit/test_live_jira_dc_conftest.py:382`), with five mutations each returning RED — including
  `ready=True` on expiry (the exact blindness 9790 removed) and restoring the deadlock itself.
* **Measurement cited in code:** `scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.py` names run 30981084637 and
  `elapsed_after_create=0.0512` as a constant, specifically so the next reader does not re-derive it.

## Testing

    gh workflow run "Live External Integration" --ref main
    pytest tests/unit/test_live_jira_dc_conftest.py -q
